episodes.title: Snatched
episodes.summary: Lily accepts a lift home, unaware of Rick's intentions.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.summary: Nearly a year later, Lily remains trapped and pregnant in Rick's dollhouse.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.summary: Five years after her kidnapping, Lily escapes - but Rick denies everything.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.summary: Rick, in prison, offers to talk on one condition: he'll only speak to Lily.

episodes.title: Crisis
episodes.summary: Lily refuses to attend Rick's trial. Abby uncovers a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.summary: With Rick on the run, a terrified Lily fears for her life.
